title: Moesha
description:

Niecy spins a fantasy about what Moesha’s life would be like if her mom raised her instead of Frank.

S2 E14 — Author, Author
Sandra writes a steamy romance novel based on characters that are suspiciously similar to her friends at 227.

Mary's new job with a travel agency takes her out-of-town on business with her boss, leaving a jealous Lester at home. Special guest appearance by Garrett Morris.

S2 E16 — Rich Kid
Mary takes a stand against the deadly drug, crack when she discovers that a wealthy and generous new friend of Calvin and Brenda is selling the drug.

S2 E17 — A Matter Of Choice
Lester wins a major contracting bid, which enables the Jenkins' to begin looking for their dream home when Lester discovers that the backers of the construction job are involved in South African investments.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E4 — The Copper Caper
Fred's suspicions about a used-copper salesman are ignored by Lamont, especially after his son checks the metal's going price. But unfortunately for everyone, Fred's instincts prove to be correct. The copper Lamont bought was stolen.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E5 — A Matter Of Life And Breath
Lamont and Fred, at Lamont's insistence, take advantage of the free tests offered by a Breathmobile. The results convince Fred that he has tuberculosis.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E6 — We Were Robbed
Fred covers his clumsiness by proclaiming 'we were robbed' and he turns into a boastful hero cited for bravery. But Lamont finds the shattered remains of his prized porcelain and glass collection and decides to teach his father a lesson.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E7 — A Pad For Lamont
Angered by his father's constant interruption of his dates, Lamont moves out to pursue the life of a swinging bachelor. But much to Lamont's disappointment, it's the newly unchaperoned Fred who is besieged by the ladies.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E8 — Great Sanford Siege
Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E9 — Coffins For Sale
Lamont buys two coffins at an auction and is determined to sell them at a large profit. Very superstitious about having coffins in the house, Fred decides to sleep in the back of the truck until they are sold.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E16 — Florence Meets Mr. Right
When George and Louise meet Florence's intended, they worry that he may be too good to be true -- and soon find out they are exactly right.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E17 — Louise's Award
Louise's donation to charity might win her a special award, if George's 'donation' to a politician doesn't ruin her chances.

title: The Jeffersons
description:

Tom Willis' latest business trip may be his last if Helen finds out who he is traveling with and what kind of 'business' they have in mind.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E19 — The Hold Out
George gets caught between his morals and his money when his efforts to increase his take on a business deal turn him into an unlikely neighborhood hero.

title: The Jeffersons
description:

The first casualty from George and Louise's vicious verbal battle could be the interviewer interested in their 'perfect marriage.
